# Deploy API to Render (one click)

After this repo is on GitHub, open Render:

1. https://dashboard.render.com/blueprints
2. **New Blueprint Instance** → connect **YashvantHange/mockcertify**
3. Set `CLIENT_URL` (after Vercel) and `ADMIN_PASSWORD`
4. Wait for deploy

Then deploy web on Vercel — see [DEPLOY.md](../DEPLOY.md).
